verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is open-source (Apache 2.0, gemini-cli-comm-10) and runs locally, storing conversation checkpoints and GEMINI.md context files on disk (gemini-cli-gh-8, gemini-cli-gh-9) and supports structured JSON/stream-JSON output (gemini-cli-gh-17, gemini-cli-gh-18), which gives a technical user some ability to access and repurpose their own data. However, there is no explicit documented 'export all my data' feature, data-portability statement, or migration tooling. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability documentation, guarantee that all session/user data is stored in open, exportable formats, and any tooling to bulk-export or migrate away from the product.
